## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are DCO-signed (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] No patient data, identifiers, clinical artifacts, private references, symlinks, or machine paths are included.
- [ ] `npm run check:boundary`, relevant tests, and formatting checks pass.
- [ ] API/SSE compatibility, documentation, accessibility, and failure paths were considered.
